// Moore machine, asynchronous reset.
module TopModule(input clk, input areset, input in, output reg out);
  reg [1:0] state;
  always @(*) begin
    case (state)
      2'b00: begin out <= 1'b0; state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b00; end
      2'b01: begin out <= 1'b1; state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b00; end
      2'b10: begin out <= 1'b0; state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; end
      2'b11: begin out <= 1'b1; state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b10; end
      default: begin out <= 1'bx; state = 2'bx; end
    endcase
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
  end
endmodule

module TopModule(input clk, input areset, input in, output reg out);
  reg [1:0] state;
  always @(*) begin
    case (state)
      2'b00: begin out <= 1'b0; state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b00; end
      2'b01: begin out <= 1'b1; state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b00; end
      2'b10: begin out <= 1'b0; state = in ? 2'b01 : 2'b10; end
      2'b11: begin out <= 1'b1; state = in ? 2'b11 : 2'b10; end
      default: begin out <= 1'bx; state = 2'bx; end
    endcase
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
  end
endmodule
